title: drones4health: Ultra-High Resolution Drone Metrics for Spatial Health Analysis
text: drones4health provides 7 modular indicator suites tailored spatial epidemiology field operations: Spectral Vegetation & Canopy Indices: Quantify photosynthetic vigor, biomass density, canopy chlorophyll (e.g., d4h_ndvi(), d4h_msavi2(), d4h_savi(), d4h_ndre(), d4h_gndvi(), d4h_vari(), d4h_evi()). Used map vegetative shading canopy roosting habitats adult mosquito vectors. Land Cover & Substrate Masks: Classify discrete land surface substrates bare soil (d4h_bare_soil()) delineate unpaved roads, exposed earth, peridomestic clearing boundaries. Hydrological & Micro-Pooling Detection: Identify open water surfaces, irrigation trenches, standing moisture pools (d4h_ndwi()) provide aquatic breeding habitats. Micro-Topography & Terrain Wetness: Model terrain slope (d4h_slope()) topographic wetness accumulation (d4h_twi()) UAV Digital Elevation Models (DEM/DSM) pinpoint natural drainage sinks runoff depressions. Eco-Epidemiological Risk Modeling: Synthesize multi-band metrics locate solid waste micro-accumulations (d4h_imsr()), hydric stagnation risk (d4h_irhe(), d4h_iev()), thermal micro-climate refuges (d4h_irts()), human-forest ecotone interfaces (d4h_irih(), d4h_ifeb()). Spatial Zonation & Surveillance Grids: Tessellate flight footprint operational hexagonal grids (d4h_hex_grid()) compute zonal summaries (d4h_summarize_grid()) community health teams larviciding logistics. Executive Reporting & Excel Export: Generate multi-moment descriptive statistics, spatial surface coverage hectares, Tukey outlier diagnostics automated multi-sheet Excel workbook export (d4h_executive_summary(), d4h_export_summary()). (full mathematical formulations derivations, see individual function pages Reference tab).

what: 3. Practical Workflow: From Raw Orthomosaics to Risk Metrics
title: drones4health: Ultra-High Resolution Drone Metrics for Spatial Health Analysis
text: indicator functions accept terra::SpatRaster objects direct file paths, automatically handle spatial co-registration, mask background NoData NA:
code: library(drones4health) library(terra)  # 1. Define paths to UAV multispectral and elevation bands path_nir <- "data/Ohuay_NIR.tif" path_r   <- "data/Ohuay_R.tif" path_re  <- "data/Ohuay_RE.tif" path_dem <- "data/Ohuay_D.tif"  # 2. Compute vegetation indices and discrete soil substrate masks r_ndvi      <- d4h_ndvi(nir = path_nir, red = path_r) r_msavi2    <- d4h_msavi2(nir = path_nir, red = path_r) r_bare_soil <- d4h_bare_soil(ndvi_raster = r_ndvi, threshold = 0.15)  # 3. Compute micro-terrain slope and topographic wetness r_slope     <- d4h_slope(dem_raster = path_dem, unit = "degrees") r_twi       <- d4h_twi(dem_raster = path_dem)  # 4. Extract artificial waste micro-accumulation risk (IMSR) r_imsr      <- d4h_imsr(red_edge = path_re, red = path_r, nir = path_nir)

Gain factor \(G\) (default: 2.5). c1 Numeric. Aerosol resistance coefficient 1 \(C_1\) (default: 6.0). c2 Numeric. Aerosol resistance coefficient 2 \(C_2\) (default: 7.5). l_factor Numeric. title: Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) — d4h_evi
text: Enhanced Vegetation Index computed : $$\text{EVI} = G \times \frac{\text{NIR} - \text{Red}}{\text{NIR} + C_1 \cdot \text{Red} - C_2 \cdot \text{Blue} + L}$$ \(G = 2.5\) gain factor, \(C_1 = 6.0\) \(C_2 = 7.5\) aerosol resistance coefficients, \(L = 1.0\) canopy background factor.
